## How to play

Guide the rover from the bottom left to the dock at the top right in twelve control ticks. Its learned policy proposes a direction. Allow a safe proposal, project an unsafe one onto a safe route, or brake and spend a tick. Projecting a proposal that was already safe costs an extra tick. Red cells are obstacles; the yellow outline marks a safe proposed destination.

## The systems concept

A learned policy can propose an action, but a separate safety gate decides what crosses into physical actuation. The toy grid shows the distinction between accepting a safe proposal, projecting an unsafe one to a safe alternative, and braking when movement must stop. Real systems need state estimation and a verified stopping model to make such decisions.
